subject: Accepted: applyRemote and anchors. Rebase after my S12a rework, which changes the same files
body: Accepted as proposed. Bumping replicaStamp on applyRemote is right: it is the same map my restamp uses. Rebase onto my next integrate first. That integrate changes: (1) InkDocument tracks replicaStamp in applyRaw (removal = max(now, updatedAt+1)) and restamp = max(now, stamp+1); (2) InkEngineOptions.labels and InkSurfaceProps.labels are required ({newTextBox, editTextBox}, from ui_copy); InkSurfaceProps.label is required; onError is now (error: InkError) with codes no_canvas / canvas_memory / too_many_items; (3) markerModeFor(surface, {hasOpaqueBlocks}) plus the InkSurface hasOpaqueBlocks prop, which 12b sets from S06's ContentRenderer; (4) live drawing uses a separate tail canvas. Inside the app use InkCanvas (apps/web/src/ink/InkCanvas.tsx); it supplies the labels. I'll post the sha.
